reason: No account and weight off by default get it past my first filter, so I'd read the privacy policy and maybe install the free version. But I don't have a diagnosis or an appointment booked, so the free logging and the free first summary cover me, and on $31k I'm not paying for Pro before I know I need it.
objection: 'Runs entirely on your phone' is easy to say. I've been burned by a period app before, and an AI write-up means my cycle data leaves the phone at some point. I'd want to know who receives it and whether they keep it.
would_change_my_mind: Getting a real PCOS appointment on the calendar. Then the $7.99 one-off with no subscription is something I'd actually pay, as long as the privacy policy holds up when I read it.
